_metadata.description: Requirements for the regenerated scenario-centric graph and contract-first planning surface.

requirements.title: Live graph from scenario-dependency-analyzer
requirements.description: TTD must build a scenario-centric graph from SDA's DescribeInterfaceGraph through a fakeable GraphSource seam, preserving scenario nodes, proto-import and Go-import edges, transport world, and stability metadata.

validation.notes: Historical 2026-06-14 declaration was complete, but no manual attestation exists. Reconciled to in_progress on 2026-09-09 per Business Health business_status_unearned:TTD-GRAPH-001. Existing mapping and graph tests do not constitute a logged live-source attestation; retain this obligation until owner evidence is earned.

requirements.title: Planned proto contract workspace
requirements.description: TTD must store planned scenarios as real .proto text files, expose filesystem-feel CRUD, validate planned contracts against live schemas, and refuse materialization on validation failure.

validation.notes: Phase 4 tests will cover file-tree CRUD, protocompile validation, finding emission, and materialize dry-run/guard behavior.

requirements.title: Capability ontology coverage layer
requirements.description: TTD must model a top-down capability ontology, link capabilities to live and planned scenarios, and compute cross-layer coverage and focus analytics.

validation.notes: Covers four-state coverage classification. Historical complete assertion reconciled to in_progress on 2026-09-09 per business_status_unearned:TTD-ONTOLOGY-001: no requirements-sync snapshot exists. Corrected the stale function name; preserve coverage and earn completion through owner evidence sync.
Covers capability, edge, and fulfillment persistence.
Covers macro topology seed mapping, hierarchy and counts. Corrected the stale function reference on 2026-09-09; this is foundation coverage, not general proposal acceptance.

requirements.title: Production planning UI
requirements.description: TTD must provide a production-ready direct UI for the graph, planned proto editor, validation findings, and ontology coverage overview with loading, error, and empty states.

validation.notes: Phase 6 tests will cover component behavior, accessibility, and loading/error/empty states.

requirements.title: scenario-dependency-analyzer source
requirements.description: TTD must consume scenario-dependency-analyzer as the canonical richer graph source through its InterfaceGraph RPC.

validation.notes: Covers SDA response mapping, including Go import evidence. Historical complete assertion reconciled to in_progress on 2026-09-09 per business_status_unearned:TTD-SDA-001: no requirements-sync snapshot exists. Preserve the test and claim history; mock mapping does not qualify live-source behavior.

requirements.title: Future strategic analysis
requirements.description: TTD may add optional AI-assisted node ideas, bottleneck analysis, and timelines only after deterministic graph and planning workflows are stable.

validation.notes: Deferred follow-up; no ollama/openrouter dependency in the current service manifest.
